title: eupatorium cannabinum var. heterophyllum
intro: Eupatorium cannabinum var. heterophyllum, commonly known as hemp agrimony, is a plant species that belongs to the Eupatorium genus. Hemp agrimony has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, colds, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of hemp agrimony include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. As an herbal remedy, hemp agrimony has been used to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and swelling, and promote wound healing.
